metadata.comparisonRule: Exact field equality and exact float64 tensor bit payloads. scoreCases persist finite float64 tensors plus row-major nonfinite patches using kinds nan, positiveInfinity, or negativeInfinity; patched indices contain stored zero and are reconstructed before both oracle implementations. All assignments and centroid tensors are copied from actual pinned FluidAudio calls. exhaustiveBinary has no redundant input tensors: its documented mask enumeration uniquely reconstructs every score matrix. Manager-driven centroid cases require active source pi indices to be strictly greater than VBxOutput.activeClusterEpsilon and output centroid count to agree, without exercising the no-active-pi fallback. Embedding assignment cases use at least two produced centroids and at most three feature rows in one chunk; activeSlots select which of the three stored feature rows are passed to the manager in ascending row order, and assignments are mapped back into three expected slots initialized to -2. K=1 is tested only through raw scoreCases because the manager deliberately takes its unconstrained branch for one centroid. An all-inactive feature-slot case has an empty activeSlots list but uniform active pi and still verifies the manager's constrained branch; it is not a no-active-pi or fallback case.
metadata.inputConstruction: All expected values are observed from the pinned FluidAudio 0.15.8 revision 87a39dfe4068fef0f1c69bfe704b2b3ef4fbc5bc implementation. scoreCases call ConstrainedClusterAssignment.assign and independently require agreement with HungarianAssignment.maxScoreAssignment after mapping -1 to -2. exhaustiveBinary enumerates masks in ascending order, row-major bit order, and stores only those direct oracle results. centroidCases call OfflineDiarizerManager.clusterAssignments with VBxOutput.gamma/pi and record the manager's computed centroids. embeddingCases call that same manager with supplied desired centroids as training embeddings, then record constrained end-to-end cosine assignments; no scores are copied or calculated by this test. SplitMix64 seeds are 0xA551_6EED_0000_0001 for continuous scores, 0xA551_6EED_0000_0002 for tied scores, and 0xA551_6EED_0000_0003 for embedding matrices.
